title: Registry manifest (registry.json)
description: The manifest served at the root of a registry. Takaro reads name, description and modules. versions stays a list of strings so that existing Takaro releases keep working; per-version data lives in the sibling versionDetails array.

version.description: The version these details belong to.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the exact bytes of <module>/<version>.json as served (UTF-8, no BOM). Hash the raw response body, never re-serialized JSON.

minTakaroVersion.description: Lowest Takaro version that can run this version. Omitted when the module does not declare one.

requiredCapabilities.description: Game server capabilities the module code uses, sorted. Informational: Takaro derives its own from the code.

name.description: Module name. Also the directory that holds its version files.

description.description: Module description (the module's summary when it has one).

versions.description: Every published version in ascending semver order.

versionDetails.description: One entry per version, in the same order as versions. Frozen once published.
